leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a reactive media query subscription in an Angular component
Apply the BreakpointObserver service to detect viewport size changes
Configure conditional rendering based on media query results
Manipulate component state in response to breakpoint changes
Integrate media query logic with Angular's change detection system
Construct responsive UI components using the BreakpointObserver API
Bind component templates to media query state variables
